selection_basis_seen_before_freeze: public repository concerns HIV-1 capsid-domain maturation
umbrella-sampling directory contains 1D steering, 2D steering, umbrella windows and WHAM outputs

frozen_question: Does projection of the HIV-1 capsid maturation free-energy landscape onto one reaction coordinate erase a persistent low-free-energy branch that remains distinguishable in the available two-dimensional representation?

frozen_algorithm.input: published numeric 2D free-energy grid or equivalent text output from the target repository
frozen_algorithm.primary_coordinate: first coordinate in the authors' 2D landscape; no semantic relabeling after inspection
frozen_algorithm.secondary_coordinate: second coordinate in the authors' 2D landscape
per_primary_bin: identify finite-energy local minima along secondary coordinate
retain minima within 2.0 kBT (or 1.2 kcal/mol if energies are kcal/mol at approximately room temperature) of the lowest minimum for that primary bin
a branch pair requires two retained minima separated by >=3 native secondary-coordinate grid steps
the intervening maximum must exceed the higher retained minimum by >=1.0 kBT (or 0.6 kcal/mol)
frozen_algorithm.persistence: branch-pair condition must hold for >=3 adjacent primary-coordinate bins
frozen_algorithm.first_break: earliest primary-coordinate bin starting a persistent branch region
frozen_algorithm.representation_debt: PASS if persistent branch pair exists; the 1D projection cannot uniquely encode branch identity at the same primary-coordinate value
frozen_algorithm.no_debt: NO_DEBT_DETECTED if no persistent branch pair meets frozen thresholds
frozen_algorithm.ambiguity: UNKNOWN if grid resolution, missing values or energy units prevent threshold evaluation

controls.deterministic_secondary_label_rewire: reverse and cyclically rotate secondary-coordinate labels within each primary bin; a claimed physical branch must depend on native adjacency rather than multiset alone
controls.energy_rank_rewire: permute non-missing energy values within each primary bin using deterministic hashes; compare maximum persistent branch length against rewired nulls
controls.null_requirement: native persistent branch length must exceed >=95% of deterministic rewires to support PASS
